hard_rules_dq: NO web-based QR login for Agentic Wallet; no scanning QR / pairing codes on third-party sites; no storing user login sessions to place orders
NO prompts that bypass user confirmation for asset actions (transfers, trades, approvals) - users must see and confirm themselves
NO unauthorized asset transfers: no scheduled collections, auto-transfers to fixed addresses, bundled extra transfers, unlimited approvals without user knowledge
Contracts MUST be open-source + verified on BscScan with clear documented owner permissions (mint/tax/pause/freeze/withdraw)
NO impersonating Binance: project names, token names, domain names must not use 'Binance' or 'BNB'
NO collecting sensitive credentials: seed phrases, private keys, API secrets, pairing codes
NO promised returns: 'passive income', 'automatic money-making' prohibited; trading products must show risk warnings
Agent ID must NOT be used to look up other people's wallets by name
NO manipulation: fake volume, mass account registrations, unusual interaction patterns => disqualification (Agent ID is 1-per-KYC-user anyway)

concept.name: Agent Achievement Badge (working title - must NOT contain 'Binance' or 'BNB')
concept.summary: Soulbound badge credential for .ai holders: claimBadge(questId) free mint gated by Agent ID registry (1 per wallet per quest), third-party attest() for portable reputation, leaderboard displays .ai handles via handleOf() not raw addresses. Weekly quests drive repeat transactions for Pioneer metrics.

innovation_rubric_fit.depth_30pct: Agent ID is the subject not a gate: badges bind achievements to .ai identity; names displayed via handleOf(); attestations make .ai reputation portable across dApps
innovation_rubric_fit.practicality_25pct: agents need verifiable track record; other dApps can query badges for trust/access decisions
innovation_rubric_fit.completion_25pct: simple contract + skill.md + leaderboard site - fully shippable in days
innovation_rubric_fit.innovation_20pct: no competitor does open multi-badge attestation registry (closest: single-score passport, lending-only credit)

Deploy BSC testnet (97) with mock registry or skip to fork-test; dry-run claim flow end-to-end
